title: 전화할 때: 걸고, 받고, 메시지 보내기
objective: By the end, you can use 10 basic phone words, including 걸다, 받다, 끊다 and 메시지, in short sentences about calling and texting.
summary: Learn ten everyday words for making calls, answering the phone, and sending text messages in Korean.

task.title: Use the phone words
task.line: Use the word list on page 1 to choose, fill in, write, or put the words in order.

words.exampleMeaning: I got a call from my mom.
I called my friend in the evening.
My cell phone is in my bag.

words.meaning: to make (a call), used with 전화를
to answer (a call), used with 전화를
words.exampleMeaning: Why aren't you answering the phone?

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 지금 회사에 전화를 (걸어요 / 받아요). ② 전화가 와요. 제가 (걸어요 / 받아요).
Fill in the blank with one word from the word list: 제 ____는 010-1234-5678이에요.
Fill in the blank with the past tense of 끊다: 수업 시간이라서 전화를 ____.
Write the Korean word: ① a text message ② a cell phone ③ what you say when you pick up the phone
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 보내 주세요 / 메시지로 / 시간을
Fill in the blank with the past tense of 전화하다: 어제 은행에 ____.
answers: ① 메시지 ② 휴대폰 ③ 여보세요
시간을 메시지로 보내 주세요. (메시지로 시간을 보내 주세요.)
